statement: Let n = len(nums). For every i,j with 0 <= i <= j < n, let D(i,j) be the number of distinct values among nums[i], nums[i+1], ..., nums[j]. Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} sum_{j=i}^{n-1} D(i,j)^2.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Under these preconditions, sum_counts(nums) returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r >= n*(n+1)/2, where n = len(nums).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r <= n*(n+1)^2*(n+2)/12, where n = len(nums).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r = n*(n+1)/2 if and only if all elements of nums are equal, i.e. for every i,k with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= k < n, nums[i] = nums[k].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r = n*(n+1)^2*(n+2)/12 if and only if the elements of nums are pairwise distinct, i.e. for every i,k with 0 <= i < k < n, nums[i] != nums[k].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Let n = len(nums). For every i,j with 0 <= i <= j < n, let D(i,j) be the number of distinct values among nums[i], ..., nums[j]. Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r >= D(i,j)^2.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Let alt be any integer array of length n such that for all p,q with 0 <= p < n and 0 <= q < n, nums[p] = nums[q] if and only if alt[p] = alt[q]. For every i,j let D_alt(i,j) be the number of distinct values among alt[i], ..., alt[j]. Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} sum_{j=i}^{n-1} D_alt(i,j)^2.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Let n = len(nums), and let rev be the array of length n with rev[k] = nums[n-1-k] for 0 <= k < n. For every i,j let D_rev(i,j) be the number of distinct values among rev[i], ..., rev[j]. Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} sum_{j=i}^{n-1} D_rev(i,j)^2.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Let n = len(nums) and let V = {v : there exists k with 0 <= k < n and nums[k] = v}. For each ordered pair (a,b) in V x V, let C(a,b) be the number of pairs (i,j) with 0 <= i <= j < n such that a occurs among nums[i], ..., nums[j] and b occurs among nums[i], ..., nums[j]. Whenever sum_counts(nums) returns a result r, r = sum_{a in V} sum_{b in V} C(a,b).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The preconditions are: 1 <= n <= 100; and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.
